data.Name: Wrath of the Guardian
data.Description: The shrine's ancient guardian has awakened — defeat it before the curse consumes everything
data.Template_Text: The ground shakes as [Enemy1], the shrine's ancient guardian, rises from the earth near [Location1]. This is no ordinary foe — it draws power from the cursed stones themselves. Steel yourself and end this threat once and for all!
data.Chain_Config: {"on_success":{"mode":"auto_activate","quest_card_id":"quest_chain_shrine_restore","inherit_placeholders":["Location1"],"message":"The guardian falls, but the shrine remains corrupted. It must be restored!","set_transition":"transition_aftermath"},"on_failure":{"mode":"none"}}
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: With a thunderous crash, [Enemy1] crumbles to dust near [Location1]. The curse weakens, but the shrine's sacred stones are still tainted. Someone must bring a pure artifact to cleanse this place...
